result.summary: Found 1 visually broken layout issue: the bottom restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed navigation bar, making the content look cut off and harder to interact with.

issues.description: The restaurant card in the lower section is being covered by the persistent bottom navigation bar, so part of the image/content is hidden off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content or reduce the fixed nav overlay so the last card can sit fully above the navigation bar.
